title: Monotonicity with mean curvature: bounded (3.17), logarithmic error (3.18), Lᵖ (4.5–4.8) and Lᵖ density (4.9)
statement: Assume (GF). Then: BoundedCurvatureMonotonicity (if V has mean curvature H in open U with |H| ≤ Λ μ_V-a.e. in U, Λ ≥ 0, then for every B_R(ξ) ⊆ U there are F with F(ρ) ∈ [e^{-Λρ}, e^{Λρ}] (0 < ρ < R) and G with G(σ,ρ) ∈ [e^{-ΛR}, e^{ΛR}] such that F(ρ)ρ^{-n}μ_V(B_ρ) − F(σ)σ^{-n}μ_V(B_σ) = G(σ,ρ)∫_{B_ρ∖B_σ} q_ξ r^{-n}dμ_V for 0 < σ ≤ ρ < R, and Θ exists and is u.s.c. on U); LogarithmicMonotonicityError (3.18); LpMonotonicity (4.5, 4.7, 4.8 with κ = (p − n)/(4p), closed endpoint ρ = R); and LpDensity (4.9).
lean_statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → BoundedCurvatureMonotonicity ∧ LogarithmicMonotonicityError ∧ LpMonotonicity ∧ LpDensity
